visual.title: Repeated squaring modulo five
visual.caption: Repeated squaring records the running residue at each bit of the exponent. The final value is the same as multiplying the base by itself the stated number of times.

predict.question: What is 2 to the tenth power modulo 5?
predict.explain: Powers of 2 modulo 5 cycle 2, 4, 3, 1. The tenth power lands on 4.
